messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — running a 60m 'stability themes' sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. Goal: finalize owners + timelines for recurring patterns from Q1 PMs. Agenda: https://redwood.app/notes/stability-themes. Please add owners by EOD today.
jon: Which recurring patterns are highest priority?
maria: Top 4 from the synthesis: 1) autoscale flaps during bursts 2) cache poisoning on prefix caching 3) model OOMs on long-context jobs 4) auth token expiry causing 401 cascades. We pulled counts + p99 latency impact into the doc.
alex: I'll take #1 — autoscale flaps. Will propose mitigations (smoother scale-down, warm pools).
sophie: I can take #2 — cache poisoning. Will draft detection + metrics (cache hit rate by route, prefix entropy).
kartik: I'll own #3 (model OOMs). Need a short runbook: safe batch limits + fallback model. I'll add to doc.
jon: For #4 — token expiry — I can coordinate with platform-auth team and set a 2-week ETA for a rolling refresh fix.
maria: Great. Proposed timelines: autoscale (3w), cache poison (4w), OOMs (2w for runbook + 6w for rollout), token fix (2w). Please comment if unrealistic.
alex: :thumbsup: 3w seems fine, but request a canary plan before full rollout. I'll write the canary steps.
sophie: Noted. I'll include failure-mode tests and a small eval harness to simulate prefix collisions.
maria: Action items (tracked in the doc):
- alex: autoscale plan + canary steps (due 2026-04-10)
- sophie: cache detection + tests (due 2026-04-17)
- kartik: OOM runbook + fallback plan (due 2026-03-31)
- jon: token refresh rollout plan (due 2026-03-30)
We'll review progress in next monthly ops sync.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for infer-service/v2 completed in us-west-2 — ~4% traffic. No errors reported.
maria: If anyone needs help ping @maria directly. Also tagging eng-sre for any infra blockers.
eng-sre: Noted — will monitor the canary and free up warm nodes if needed.
jon: I'll update the retro tickets with the owners + link to doc.
maria: Thanks all — see you tomorrow. If anyone can't make 10am PT, pls record notes in the doc.
